subject: Clearwater — ISO27001 + SIG control mapping and evidence staging
messages:
From: Elena Ramos <elena.ramos@clearwater.com>
To: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@clearwater.com, nate.liu@clearwater.com
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Controls and artifacts request — ISO27001 + SIG mapping

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for taking the time on the product overview call yesterday. As part of our procurement review we need a tighter mapping of Redwood controls to our baseline (ISO 27001 Annex A) and the SIG questionnaire. Specifically, can you provide: 

- A completed ISO27k-to-SIG crosswalk (sheet per control family) with control owner at Redwood.
- The latest SOC 2 Type II executive summary (redacted as needed).
- Sample KMS key rotation logs for the last 90 days (redacted key IDs ok).
- Network scope diagram showing VPC boundaries, ingress/egress points, and where telemetry is collected.
- Pen test or vulnerability scan summary and remediation status.

Target: we'd like to ingest artifacts into our Vendor Assurance Portal by Friday 7/2 so our InfoSec team can work through the questionnaire next week. If you need more time we can push the intake window but please confirm what you can deliver and by when.

Two quick clarifications: 1) our SIG request includes an ask about retention of prompt history for hosted API customers — can you confirm configurable retention windows and where retention controls are enforced? 2) For private deployment customers, what evidence can you provide around network isolation (e.g., attestations, diagrams, or third-party assessments)?

Appreciate your help — copying Nate from our procurement team who will track the intake in the portal.

Best,
Elena Ramos
Head of Vendor Assurance
Clearwater Financial

Attachments: (none in this message)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Ramos <elena.ramos@clearwater.com>
Cc: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Controls and artifacts request — ISO27001 + SIG mapping

Elena —

Thanks for the clear list. We can get an initial intake package to you by EOD Thursday (7/1) and a fuller crosswalk + supplementary artifacts by Monday (7/5). High level notes below and a proposed mutual action plan attached.

Quick answers to your clarifications:
- Retention of prompt/interaction history: hosted API customers can configure retention windows at account level (retention: 0/30/90/365 days). By default we retain transactional logs for 30 days; extended retention is available under contract for Dedicated/Private customers. Enforcement is at the request-processing layer and persisted in encrypted object storage; we will include an architecture diagram and sample retention policy enforcement logs.
- Private deployments: evidence we can provide includes network diagrams, attestations of customer-managed VPC peering, and an operational checklist for air-gapped on-prem packages. For partner-provided third-party assessments, we can share redacted reports where allowed.

Attached: redwood_iso_crosswalk_v1.xlsx (initial crosswalk), scope_vpc_topology.png (diagram), soc2_type2_summary_2025.pdf (executive summary).

Proposed intake milestones (also in the attached MAP):
1) 7/1 EOD — initial artifact bundle to vendor portal (crosswalk v1, diagram, SOC2 exec summary)
2) 7/5 — KMS rotation logs + pen-test summary + updated crosswalk with owners
3) 7/9 — final SIG responses and any requested redactions

Please confirm the portal upload destination or if you'd prefer we send artifacts via a secure ShareFile link instead of HubSpot/portal ingest. Happy to jump on 30 minutes if you want to walk through the crosswalk.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Director, Product Security (Redwood Inference)
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: redwood_iso_crosswalk_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet), scope_vpc_topology.png (image/png), soc2_type2_summary_2025.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: FW: Controls and artifacts request — ISO27001 + SIG mapping

Team — looping you in for artifact collection. Notes and owners below. Please assemble the files into the secure intake folder and flag any items that need legal/CISO approval before redaction.

Owners/asks:
- SOC2 summary: Marcus (I will confirm redaction scope) — deliver: soc2_type2_summary_2025.pdf
- Crosswalk + SIG rows with owners: Soojin / Jonas — deliver: redwood_iso_crosswalk_v1.xlsx (sheet per Annex A family)
- KMS/key rotation logs: Infra (Pradeep) via Jonas — sample attached: kms_rotation_sample.log (redacted)
- VPC topology + telemetry: Cloud Infra (Jonas) — deliver: scope_vpc_topology.png + updated flow log config snippet
- Pen test vignette: Security (Mina) — deliver summary and remediation statuses

Checklist for intake folder (use this exact naming):
/Clearwater/2027-06-intake/
- crosswalk/redwood_iso_crosswalk_v1.xlsx
- artifacts/soc2_type2_summary_2025.pdf
- artifacts/kms_rotation_sample.log
- diagrams/scope_vpc_topology.png
- reports/pen_test_summary_2027.pdf (if available)

Deadline: get the initial bundle into the shared Drive folder by 7/1 16:00 PT. If any item is blocked, escalate to me and I'll coordinate with CISO/legal.

Marcus
VP, Solutions Engineering — Redwood Inference

Attachments: kms_rotation_sample.log (text/plain)

From: Elena Ramos <elena.ramos@clearwater.com>
To: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: nate.liu@clearwater.com, security@clearwater.com
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 14:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Controls and artifacts request — ISO27001 + SIG mapping

Soojin / Marcus —

Thanks, that cadence works. We'll accept the initial bundle in Google Drive at the link below (please place files under /Clearwater/2027-06-intake/). Nate will confirm the portal ingest details after he sees the bundle.

One ask before you upload: in your crosswalk please include for each control whether the evidence is: 
- "document" (policy/procedure), 
- "artifact" (log/report/diagram), or 
- "attestation" (email/statement from Redwood exec).

Also, on retention: if you can include sample config snippet or API call that shows how an account owner changes retention that will speed our review.

I'll watch for the Drive upload and will route to our InfoSec reviewers.

Best regards,
Elena Ramos
Head of Vendor Assurance
Clearwater Financial

Related upload destination: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AqX-Redwood-ISO-Crosswalk

Attachments: (none)
